newsitem.title: USA: McCrory in deal to liquidate assets at 300 stores.
newsitem.headline: McCrory in deal to liquidate assets at 300 stores.

text.p: Bankrupt retailer McCrory Corp said Wednesday it had agreed to liquidate all inventory, furniture, fixtures and equipment at 300 clothing stores.
The agreement, with Nassi Group LLC and Schottenstein-Bernstein Capital Group LLC, should provide McCrory with $45-$50 million, McCrory said.
McCrory will use proceeds to reduce its borrowings under a credit agreement with CIT Group/Business Credit Inc, the company said.

On January 8, McCrory said it had defaulted on the credit agreement by failing to satisfy a "clean-up" provision, which required that McCrory's outstanding debt, excluding letters of credit, not exceed $30 million on Dec 31, 1996.
McCrory said its debt, excluding letters of credit, totalled $52 million.
McCrory and CIT have agreed to allow the liquidation to occur, enabling McCrory to raise cash to address the clean-up provision, McCrory said.
A hearing on the liquidation agreement is scheduled for January 23 in U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York, McCrory said.
